title: EcoPulse Health Contract
description: Single shared health schema implemented by every EcoPulse service tier (backend, ai_service, genai-service) so that probes, the /api/health/status aggregator, and the admin UI render consistently. See docs/contracts/health-v1.md.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Bumped only on a breaking shape change.

service.description: Stable service identifier, e.g. ecopulse-backend, ecopulse-ai-service, ecopulse-genai-service.

status.description: Overall health, derived as the WORST of the service's own state and every check.

checkedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which the check was performed.

checks.description: Per-dependency results. May be empty for a pure liveness probe (/health/live).

id.description: Stable dependency identifier, e.g. mongodb, ai_service, model, gemini.

latencyMs.description: Probe round-trip latency in milliseconds. null when not measurable.

details.description: Opaque, NON-SENSITIVE diagnostic fields (booleans, counts, public identifiers). MUST NOT contain secrets.
